plainTranslation: A's feelings meets B's need for freedom. The square puts them in friction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort press against your need for freedom and openness to change.
summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort press against your need for freedom and openness to change. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
